hero.description: Modes, zone rules, door/window contacts, schedules, sunrise/sunset, lux and automatic mode.

submodes.title: Sub modes
submodes.description: Create extra choices under a main mode, for example Watch TV under Home.

zones.title: Zone rules
zones.description: Motion, door/window contacts, subzones, lights, dimming and conditions.

temperature.title: Temperature per mode and zone
temperature.description: Set the desired temperature per mode and zone. Devices with target_temperature are updated automatically when the mode changes.

appliances.title: Appliance notifications
appliances.description: Detect start and ready status using power consumption from a smart plug or device with measure_power.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Switch lights/devices on or off at a fixed time, random time, sunrise or sunset. Optionally use lux per zone.

import_export.title: Import / export
import_export.description: Create a backup of everything or choose which sections to include.

export.title: Export
export.description: Choose sections and copy a JSON backup.

import.title: Import
import.description: Choose a previously created JSON backup. You can then select which sections to restore.
import.placeholder: Paste the JSON export here if choosing a file does not work
